summary: Iteration 2 backend testing for the 4 NEW modules (POS, Payroll T4, Fleet GPS, Inventory) completed. 29/29 new pytest cases passed (100%), and the full backend suite is now 56/56 (100%) with no regressions to iteration_1's 27 tests. Verified: GET /api/pos/products lists seeded products, supports ?category= filter (Hardware), treats category=all as no-op, and isolates per-company; POST /api/pos/sales returns 400 on empty cart and 400 when all product_ids are invalid, filters unknown ids while accepting valid ones, computes subtotal/HST=13%/total exactly, persists to db.sales (verified via MongoClient), and leaks no _id; GET /api/pos/sales lists recent sales without _id and includes the just-created sale; GET /api/payroll/runs returns per-company seeded runs with required keys and isolates between companies; GET /api/payroll/t4/{employee_id} returns 404 for unknown ids and a real T4 with boxes 14/16/18/22/net where net == gross - cpp - ei - tax within rounding, employer.co_id matches active company; GET /api/fleet/vehicles returns vehicles with speed_kmh & heading in valid ranges, two consecutive calls produce different lat/lng (mock GPS drift) and respect company isolation; GET /api/inventory/items lists items with no _id and isolates per company; GET /api/inventory/lookup returns found=false on bogus barcode and found=true with the matching item/product when probed with a real seeded barcode from either db.inventory or db.products. All 9 new endpoints (and POST /api/pos/sales) return 401 without a Bearer token. No _id leaked in any response inspected.

minor.issue: Empty barcode results in 422 (FastAPI required-query rejection) before the explicit 400 branch can fire — `if not barcode` is dead code. Behaviour is acceptable but the inline 400 check is unreachable.

Sale persistence uses `await db.sales.insert_one(sale)` then mutates `sale` in place (pop _id, isoformat created_at) and returns it; safe today but follows the same ObjectId-mutation footgun fixed in iteration_1 — consider building a clean response dict instead of mutating the inserted document.

action_items: Consider returning a freshly-built response dict from POST /api/pos/sales instead of mutating the inserted document (defensive against future ObjectId leakage).
Either remove the unreachable `if not barcode` 400 branch in /api/inventory/lookup or change the query param to Optional[str] = None so the explicit 400 is reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: POS subtotal/HST/total math uses round() per line then on subtotal*0.13; tested values matched exactly for 2-item carts but for larger carts cumulative rounding could differ from naive sum — verified within current test fixtures.
Fleet drift uses `random` module-level import inside the handler each call; harmless but consider importing once at module top.
T4 mock uses `sum(ord(c) for c in emp['name'])` for deterministic income — if emp name is missing this would 500; current seed always has name so untested.
server.py has grown past 900 lines (was 640 in iter 1) — strong candidate for splitting into routers (pos, payroll, fleet, inventory, ai, hr) before more modules are added.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data required. App startup auto-seeds db.products, db.vehicles, db.inventory, db.pay_runs for the 3 demo companies. Tests reused the existing conftest seeded_user fixture (Bearer token inserted directly into user_sessions). Each POS sale created during testing is cleaned up via mongo.sales.delete_one after assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For future module additions follow the same pattern: use conftest.seeded_user for Bearer; switch active company via POST /api/companies/switch before reading per-company collections; assert no `_id` in every response; verify persistence by querying MongoDB directly (mongo fixture in conftest). EXPO_BACKEND_URL is consumed via conftest with fall-throughs to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL then the preview URL. New test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_new_modules.py with class-per-module layout (TestPOSProducts, TestPOSSales, TestPayroll, TestFleet, TestInventory).
rca_of_issue: No issues found in iteration_2. All 11 explicit acceptance criteria from the review request were validated by individual assertions in test_new_modules.py.
